Alex Rivera
San Francisco, CA | (555) 234-5678 | alex.rivera@email.com
linkedin.com/in/alexrivera-dev | github.com/alexrivera-dev

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Versatile Full Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience designing and shipping scalable web applications and REST APIs. Proficient in Python, JavaScript, React, and PostgreSQL, with hands-on expertise in Docker containerization and CI/CD pipelines.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, SQL, HTML5, CSS3
Frameworks & Libraries: React, Node.js, Express, Flask, Django, Tailwind CSS
Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB
Cloud & DevOps: Docker, AWS (S3, EC2), Git, CI/CD, Linux, Nginx
Concepts: REST API, Microservices, Agile/Scrum, Unit Testing, System Design

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer | TechNova Solutions | Austin, TX
June 2023 - Present
- Architected and delivered 14+ high-throughput REST API endpoints in Python (Flask) and PostgreSQL, handling over 250,000 daily active requests with 99.9% uptime.
- Spearheaded the frontend migration of internal analytics dashboard to React and TypeScript, accelerating page load speeds by 42%.
- Containerized backend services with Docker and configured GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, reducing deployment roll-out cycle from 45 minutes to 7 minutes.
- Integrated Redis caching layer for frequent database queries, slashing median response latency by 58%.

Junior Web Developer | CloudBridge Systems | San Jose, CA
July 2021 - May 2023
- Developed responsive frontend user interfaces using React, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS for client-facing SaaS platform.
- Collaborated in an Agile/Scrum team of 8 engineers to design relational database schemas in MySQL.
- Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests using PyTest and Jest, achieving 88% code coverage.

PROJECTS
ResumeIQ - AI Career Intelligence Platform | Python, Flask, React, Docker
- Built an intelligent resume diagnostic engine that parses PDF/DOCX resumes and maps skills against industry job descriptions using NLP and pattern extraction.
- Implemented evidence-based skill scoring algorithm, providing actionable gap recommendations and automated ReportLab PDF reports.
- Containerized application with Docker Compose and published open-source documentation.

E-Commerce Microservices Engine | Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST API
- Designed transactional shopping cart and order processing backend supporting 1,000 concurrent checkouts.
- Engineered automated JWT authentication and Stripe webhook integration with robust idempotency guarantees.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
University of California, Davis | Graduated: June 2021 | GPA: 3.82 / 4.0

CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (2024)
- 1st Place Winner - NorCal University Hackathon 2021
